# MANHWAS

> Read manhwa and manhua online free. 2,000+ series with daily chapter
> updates, weekly rankings, a release calendar, and genre browsing.
> No account needed to read.

MANHWAS (https://manhwas.site) is a digital-comics discovery and reader
platform for Korean manhwa and Chinese manhua. The catalogue refreshes
every 2 hours from public sources; chapter pages carry full reader context
(series, chapter number, related titles). Series pages include synopsis,
author, status, genre, chapter count, and alt titles.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://manhwas.site/): featured and trending series, latest updates
- [Catalog](https://manhwas.site/catalog): all series with filters
- [Manhwa hub](https://manhwas.site/manhwa): Korean comics, browse by genre and status
- [Manhua hub](https://manhwas.site/manhua): Chinese comics, browse by genre and status
- [Latest updates](https://manhwas.site/updates): chapters released by day
- [New releases](https://manhwas.site/new-releases): newest debuting series
- [Rankings](https://manhwas.site/rankings): most-read series this week
- [Calendar](https://manhwas.site/calendar): weekly release schedule
- [Genres](https://manhwas.site/genres): genre directory (action, romance, fantasy, …)

## Popular series

- [Solo Leveling](https://manhwas.site/manhwa/solo-leveling)
- [Lookism](https://manhwas.site/manhwa/lookism)
- [Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint](https://manhwas.site/manhwa/omniscient-readers-viewpoint)
- [Eleceed](https://manhwas.site/manhwa/eleceed)
- [Tower of God](https://manhwas.site/manhwa/tower-of-god)

## Series URL format

- Series: https://manhwas.site/manhwa/{title-slug} (manhua: /manhua/{title-slug})
- Chapter: https://manhwas.site/read/{title-slug}/chapter-{n}

## Data

- [Sitemap (series and hub pages)](https://manhwas.site/sitemap.xml)
- [Sitemap (chapter pages)](https://manhwas.site/sitemap-chapters.xml)
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://manhwas.site/catalog.json): full series index
- Covers are served from https://cdn.manhwas.site/covers/
